pr_title: release-23.2: changefeedccl: Avoid logging when context may be canceled
pr_body:
Backport 1/1 commits from #114583.

/cc @cockroachdb/release

---

Calling log  methods on a context that's already canceled may produce "use of Span after Finish" under tests. Avoid doing that when pacing CPU usage.

Fixes #114130

Release note: None

---

Release justification: removes a use of Span after Finish 

---

Fixes #141917

This appears to have been fixed on 24.1 and later by this PR: #114583. I'll backport it to 23.2.
Removing release blocker since this is not a new issue.
